card.name: Capital G after digits or codes
card.fires_on: The letter G (or g/W) standing alone right after a digit or short alphanumeric code, as in 4G, 2G, C3G or model numbers. Also fires on a lone g in command flags.

modes.label: G after number
modes.description: Capital G glued to a digit, as in generation labels or part numbers.

modes.label: G in disease or code names
modes.description: G ending a short code such as the C3G kidney disease name.

modes.label: Lone letter in other codes
modes.description: A single letter in flags, intervals, or part names.

card.plain: It spots a single letter G tacked onto a number or code, like 4G or C3G.
